cost_metric: expected preparation-family calls per usable sample
important_interpretation: The amplitude-amplification iteration count that maximizes success probability is not necessarily the iteration count that minimizes expected cost per usable correlation-state sample.
cost_warning: The metric uses a logical preparation-family-call proxy (1 + 2t). It is not a physical gate count. Reversible data access, reflections, oracle depth, ancilla overhead, and hardware noise are not included.
